archive_method: All 16 original files extracted byte-for-byte. SHA256SUMS covers original files only. Post-collection work is confined to audit/ and a separate documentation review; frozen plan and original pending-review reports are unchanged.
explanation_review: All 216 scheduled responses read and coded against the frozen rubric, unblinded to prompt, reference values and final choice. No independent human rater or inter-rater reliability estimate.
verification: Original freeze, items, config, decoding and all generated automatic reports reproduced using the recorded code. A separate stdlib verifier independently derives truth from literal prompts and verifies thresholds, pairs, raw parsing, original-file hashes and label bindings.
